descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Are you at the beginning of your engineering career and passionate about embedded systems, automotive technology, and testing?
 We're looking for a Junior System Test Engineer to join an engineering team working on advanced automotive battery systems. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your technical skills, work with experienced engineers, and contribute to the verification and validation of innovative embedded technologies.
 🔧 What will you do?
 Support the preparation, development, and maintenance of system integration and system qualification test specifications.
 Design and execute test cases based on system requirements, architecture, interfaces, and customer specifications.
 Perform manual and automated tests on embedded systems and automotive battery-management functions.
 Work with test environments such as Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) systems, battery test benches, measurement equipment, and diagnostic tools.
 Verify communication and interfaces between system components, including CAN and LIN networks.
 Execute functional, boundary-condition, robustness, and fault-injection tests while following applicable laboratory safety procedures.
 Analyze test results, document defects, and support troubleshooting activities with cross-functional engineering teams.
 Maintain traceability between system requirements, test cases, results, and identified defects.
 Contribute to test reports, technical reviews, and continuous improvement of testing methods and tools.
 🎯 What are we looking for?
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
 Up to 2 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, system testing, automotive electronics, or battery systems. Internships and university projects are also welcome.
 Basic understanding of embedded systems and hardware-software interactions.
 Familiarity with verification and validation principles, test case design, and defect reporting.
 Basic knowledge of electrical engineering and laboratory equipment.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to work.
 Good communication and teamwork skills.
 Good written and spoken English.
 ⭐ It would be a plus if you have:
 Exposure to automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, UDS, or XCP.
 Familiarity with Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape) or HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI, or Vector.
 Experience with Python, CAPL, MATLAB, or other scripting and test automation tools.
 Knowledge of Automotive SPICE, particularly SYS.4 and SYS.5.
 Familiarity with requirements and test management tools such as DOORS, Jama, Codebeamer, or Polarion.
 Basic knowledge of automotive battery systems, Battery Management Systems (BMS), and functional safety principles, including ISO 26262.
 Experience with laboratory measurement equipment, version control, or defect-tracking tools such as Jira.
